problem_statement: Small business owners in India cannot obtain working capital loans quickly from traditional banks.
customer_segment: Small business owners in India with 5-50 employees and annual revenue of 2-50 Cr INR
consequence: They miss growth opportunities, struggle with cash flow gaps, and resort to informal lenders at high rates
assumptions: They have GST data, bank statements, and digital payment history but banks still require collateral and a 3-month process
proposed_solution: An AI-powered lending platform that uses GST and bank transaction data to provide working capital loans within 48 hours
